employeeIntegration.subtitle: Comprehensive support for successful integration in Germany
employeeIntegration.description: We offer specially designed integration programs for international employees to successfully integrate into Germany.

section1.title: Employee Integration
section1.content: After international employees successfully arrive in Germany, the critical process of integration begins. Good integration is important not only to ensure that new employees feel comfortable in their new environment, but also to ensure long-term commitment to the company. Companies can make a significant contribution with targeted measures aimed at providing a smooth start for new professionals.

section2.title: Support Services
section2.content: We provide comprehensive services including language training, cultural orientation, legal consultation, and social integration support.

employeeIntegration.benefits: Rapid adaptation, high job satisfaction, and long-term success

experiencedVisa.title: Visa for Experienced Professionals
experiencedVisa.subtitle: Special visa program for qualified experienced specialists
experiencedVisa.description: We offer accelerated visa processes and special opportunities for professionals with at least 2 years of professional experience.

section1.title: Visa for Experienced Professionals
section1.content: The visa for experienced professionals (Section 19c, Paragraph 2 of the Residence Act) is aimed at skilled workers who have at least two years of qualified professional experience in their field but do not have a formal university degree. The visa allows these skilled workers to work in Germany, especially in professions that are in high demand. This visa was introduced to meet the demand for skilled workers and strengthen the German labor market.

section2.title: Application Process
section2.content: We provide professional guidance for the evaluation of your experience certificates, recognition of professional qualifications, and accelerated application processes.

experiencedVisa.benefits: Fast process, flexible conditions, and experience-oriented evaluation

acceleratedProcedure.title: Accelerated Skilled Worker Procedure
acceleratedProcedure.subtitle: Fast and efficient visa application process
acceleratedProcedure.description: We shorten your visa process with the accelerated procedure specially designed for skilled workers.

section1.title: What is the Accelerated Skilled Worker Procedure?
section1.content: The Accelerated Skilled Worker Procedure is a special process developed to accelerate the immigration and recognition process for skilled workers from abroad. Its primary purpose is to help companies bring urgently needed skilled workers to Germany faster and combat the skills shortage more effectively. This process is based on close cooperation between employers, immigration authorities and recognition institutions to minimize bureaucratic barriers and issue permits quickly.

section2.title: Advantages
section2.content: We optimize your process with short waiting times, priority processing, and special consultant appointments.
